Sentinel

AI-Powered Crisis Response Platform for Natural Disasters

An AI-powered crisis response platform designed for natural disaster mitigation. The system ingests citizen disaster reports, applies Gemini API for real-time NLP triage and severity assessment, and coordinates incident visualization with automated victim-to-shelter resource matching.

Key Capabilities & Features:

  • Citizen disaster reporting with geolocation metadata
  • NLP triage and urgency extraction via Gemini API
  • AI severity scoring and multi-language translation
  • Real-time crisis mapping and victim/resource visualization
  • Responder coordination and mission dispatching
  • Emergency shelter and relief resource matching

EvidenceLens

AI-Assisted Fact Verification & Evidence Synthesis

An AI-assisted evidence verification platform that moves beyond black-box generative answers. The system systematically searches verified sources and presents supporting evidence and citations so users can clearly understand why a claim is considered true, false, or uncertain.

Core Principle:

Evidence-backed AI rather than answer-only AI.

Smart Energy Classroom

Autonomous Computer Vision & Appliance Control System

A smart classroom system that detects occupancy and human distribution using computer vision and automatically controls electrical appliances (fans and lights) through microcontrollers and relay modules.

  • Human and pose detection via MediaPipe & OpenCV
  • Autonomous light & fan relay switching
  • Serial communication bridge with Arduino
  • Local monitoring dashboard for energy analytics
